summary.usage: Hành động đang diễn ra; cần cả be và V-ing.
summary.example: Look! The children are feeding the rabbits.
summary.exampleVi: Nhìn kìa! Các em đang cho thỏ ăn.

summary.formula: short adjective + -er + than / more + long adjective + than
summary.usage: So sánh hai người hoặc vật; không dùng more cùng đuôi -er.
summary.example: This turtle is smaller than that one.
summary.exampleVi: Con rùa này nhỏ hơn con kia.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: Look! The children ___ feeding the rabbits at the moment.
items.why: Children số nhiều; hành động đang diễn ra dùng are + V-ing.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: Listen! The little bird is ___ near the open window.
items.why: Hiện tại tiếp diễn cần be + V-ing, nên is singing.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: The zookeeper ___ cleaning the elephant's pool right now.
items.why: The zookeeper số ít nên is cleaning.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: This turtle is ___ than the one beside it; it fits in a smaller box.
items.why: Tính từ ngắn small thêm -er khi so sánh hai vật.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: The elephant is ___ than the rabbit.
items.why: Big thành bigger, gấp đôi g; có than là so sánh hơn.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: This documentary is ___ interesting than the short advert.
items.why: Tính từ dài interesting dùng more ... than.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: The guide is speaking ___ now, so please listen.
items.why: Speaking là động từ; quietly bổ nghĩa cách nói.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: The children are ___ the animals from a safe distance.
items.why: Sau are ở hiện tại tiếp diễn cần watching.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: A rabbit is usually ___ than an elephant.
items.why: Light là tính từ ngắn; dùng lighter than.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: This cage is ___ than the old one, so the birds have more space.
items.why: So sánh hai chiếc lồng dùng larger than.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: The pupils ___ drawing animals now; they are listening to the guide.
items.why: The pupils số nhiều; phủ định tiếp diễn dùng are not + V-ing.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 9 · Grammar
items.scene: Which sentence describes an action happening now?
options: The vet is checking the puppy.
The vet checks pets every day.
The vet will check it tomorrow.
items.answer: The vet is checking the puppy.
items.why: Is checking diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra; ba câu kia là thói quen, quá khứ và tương lai.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.
